name: Flocknote
shortDescription: A US church communications and member-management platform with email, text messages, sign-ups, giving and household records.
suitableContexts: Churches prioritising email and text communication
Catholic parishes and churches managing registrations and households

pricing.summary: Flocknote publishes US-dollar member-band pricing, including a free Starter tier for up to 40 members. Its paid Complete plan adds $75 per month to the applicable Starter member-band price.

tiers.label: Starter, up to 40 members
tiers.detail: Supplier states it is free for life

tiers.label: Complete
tiers.detail: Adds member database, registrations and advanced giving tools

pricing.trialDetails: The supplier advertises an unlimited free trial with no card required.

support: Training and migration for enterprise accounts

editorial.assessment: Flocknote has unusually clear US pricing and a communication-led product shape. UK churches should confirm SMS delivery and consent rules, data processing, payment availability, Gift Aid and GBP billing before considering it a practical UK alternative.
bestFor: Teams that want communications and sign-ups before a full operational suite
Churches able to test communications consent and household workflows during the trial
strengths: Free small-network tier and unlimited trial
Strong email, text and sign-up emphasis
limitations: Ask the supplier about UK payment, Gift Aid, data-processing and messaging compliance

procurementVerdict.problem: Teams that want communications and sign-ups before a full operational suite

longForm.verdict: Flocknote is most relevant where scattered church communication is the primary pain point. Its value should be assessed by whether it can centralise permissions, groups and sign-ups without creating a second uncontrolled people database.

decisionLens.heading: Communication convenience must sit inside a consent process.
decisionLens.text: Email, text, groups and sign-up forms are powerful only when the church can explain why someone is contacted, manage preferences and export records safely. Test opt-in, opt-out and administrator roles before importing the whole address book.

sections.heading: Communication first, database second
sections.question: Will it simplify outreach without duplicating records?
paragraphs: Flocknote publishes email, standard texting, sign-ups, giving and household-management tools. Its Complete plan adds a wider member and registration feature set.

Run a trial with one real newsletter, event sign-up and volunteer reminder. For a UK church, separately confirm text-message delivery, consent handling, data-processing terms and how any online payments would interact with Gift Aid.

userFeedback.summary: This profile does not use an independent review score. It is based on Flocknote’s published pricing and feature information.
themes: The free tier can make a communication pilot easy to start.
The main UK due diligence is messaging consent, payments and data processing.
userFeedback.caveat: Supplier feature statements and public ratings are not independent testing or evidence of UK compliance.

faq.question: Does Flocknote have a free plan?
faq.answer: Yes. Flocknote advertises Starter as free for life for networks of up to 40 members.

faq.question: Does Flocknote offer a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes. The supplier advertises an unlimited free trial without a card.

faq.question: How much does Flocknote cost?
faq.answer: Pricing is in US dollars and varies by member count. The supplier lists Starter at $10/month for 41–50 members and Complete as the Starter price plus $75/month.

faq.question: Does Flocknote support UK Gift Aid?
faq.answer: Ask the supplier to demonstrate payment availability, Gift Aid and donor reporting directly with Flocknote.

seo.description: Independent Flocknote profile for UK churches: US pricing, free trial, communications and member tools, UK checks and FAQs.
